title.en: Character consistency in AI short drama: identity, costume and shot continuity
title.zh: AI 短剧怎样保持角色跨镜一致：人物、造型与镜头状态

answer.en: Separate the person’s persistent identity from the current costume and each shot’s action. Keep only genuinely unchanged visual facts in a continuity lock; track hands, props and gaze as shot state. An original three-shot archive scene below shows how to connect these decisions. A character sheet or an image-prompt ID is not a generated reference image, and written constraints do not guarantee a model’s results. For the wider adaptation workflow, start with the [novel-to-short-drama guide](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama).
answer.zh: 先把不随换装改变的人物身份、当前造型与每镜动作分开。只把真正跨镜不变的外观写入连续性锁，手持物、视线和姿势则按镜头记录。下面用原创的档案馆三镜示例，说明怎样把这些决定连起来。有角色设定或图片提示词编号，不等于已有真实参考图；文字约束也不保证模型最终效果。完整改编流程可从[小说改短剧指南](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama)开始。

en: An accepted scene or episode script. It should establish who appears, which visible state matters and what changes during each shot; resolve story meaning in writing rather than hiding it inside an appearance prompt.
Creator-approved identity facts and scene styling. Do not invent age, ethnicity, facial traits, branded clothing or other details merely to fill a template. Mark unresolved choices instead.

If you plan to use the documented skills, a configured supported agent host and project folder. This guide does not execute image or video generation and its example contains no generated reference asset.
zh: 准备已接受的场次或单集剧本，写清谁出现、哪些可见状态重要、每镜发生什么变化。知识、目标和关系属于编剧，不要把故事语义藏进外观提示词。
准备创作者确认过的身份事实与本场造型。不要为了填模板擅自补年龄、族裔、五官、品牌服装等细节；未决定的内容继续标为待定。
如要使用文档中的技能，还需已配置的受支持 Agent 宿主和项目目录。本指南不执行图片或视频生成，示例也没有生成参考素材。

en: Write Character as the persistent identity

Use observable, comparable anchors that survive a costume change and work beyond a front-facing close-up. In the example, Lin Lan has a V-shaped nape hairline and a right shoulder that sits slightly lower than the left. These belong to Character; the rain jacket, hand-held key, gaze and pose do not. Ask `short-drama-assets` to record the accepted facts in `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`.
Add one compatible Look for this scene

Reference the Character, then record only clothing, hair arrangement, makeup, injury or weathering that can coexist now. Lin Lan’s scene Look is a low-tied hairstyle and a dark-teal matte hooded work jacket with two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff. Keep the brass key as a Prop and its current holder as shot state; neither is part of the Look.
Lock only the invariant visible surface

A LOCK is justified when the fact appears across at least two shots, viewers could notice a mismatch and the story does not change it. Use the minimal phrase “dark-teal matte hooded work jacket, hood down, two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff” across the affected `IMG-*` body, frozen keyframe and `MOTION-*` body. Do not lock the key’s position, hand pose or gaze because those change.
Chain three shots with explicit states

For every shot write `start → one primary action → end`, including each hand, held prop and gaze. The next shot must start from the previous shot’s actual end unless the screenplay establishes a cut or state change. A frozen keyframe normally describes the start only; it must not show an action or prop state that first appears at the end.
Keep prompt IDs separate from media evidence

Use `short-drama-image-prompts` only to author entries such as `IMG-CHAR-LINLAN` and `IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN`; those IDs do not prove files exist. In `short-drama-storyboard`, bind an inspected project image as `REF-*`. If the creator will supply it later, keep a `PLAN-*` slot with order, intended file, purpose, control scope and exclusions. Missing files must not be silently downgraded to text-to-video.
Stop at a production-honest handoff

A `PLAN-*` shot may describe the intended image-to-video path, but it cannot enter `short-drama-produce` until the real file is present and the slot becomes `REF-*`. For a continuing shot chain, later segments also need the preceding actual video and actual tail frame; planned frames or prose cannot substitute. Text constraints improve the handoff, but do not guarantee a model will preserve face, clothing, space, props or motion.
zh: 先写长期不变的 Character 身份
选换装后仍成立、可观察、可比较，并能在侧面或背面识别的锚点。示例中的林岚有 V 形后颈发际，右肩略低于左肩；这些属于 Character。雨衣、手里的钥匙、视线和姿势都不属于身份。可用 `short-drama-assets` 把已确认事实写入 `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`。
再写本场相容的 Look
先引用 Character，只补本场能同时存在的服装、发型、妆伤与天气化。林岚本场是低束发，穿墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，左袖有双排银色按扣。黄铜钥匙仍是 Prop，由谁拿着属于镜头状态，不能吞进 Look。
只锁真正不变的可见表面
同一事实跨至少两镜可见、观众能发现不一致、剧情又不会改变它，才写 LOCK。示例锁面是“墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，帽子放下，左袖双排银色按扣”，在受影响的 `IMG-*` 正文、冻结关键帧和 `MOTION-*` 正文中原样携带。钥匙位置、手势和视线会变化，不上锁。
用状态链写三镜
每镜都按“起点 → 唯一主要动作 → 终点”记录双手、持物与视线；除非剧本明确跳时空，下一镜起点应继承上一镜真实终点。冻结关键帧默认只写起点，不能提前出现终点才成立的动作或道具状态。
把提示词编号与真实素材分开
`short-drama-image-prompts` 可写 `IMG-CHAR-LINLAN`、`IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN`，但编号不证明图片存在。到 `short-drama-storyboard`，检查过且项目内可读的图片才写 `REF-*`；创作者计划稍后提供时保留 `PLAN-*`，注明顺序、拟用文件、用途、控制范围与不得控制范围。缺图不能静默降级为文生视频。
以诚实的投产边界收尾
`PLAN-*` 可以记录预期的图生视频路径，但真实文件入项并改为 `REF-*` 前，不能交给 `short-drama-produce`。连续时空的后续段还需要上一段实际视频和实际尾帧；文字或计划帧不能冒充。文本约束能改善交接，却不保证模型最终稳定人脸、服装、空间、道具或动作。

ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — written for this guide, not skill output, generated media or a production test.
Scene: At a rain-soaked archive loading bay, Lin Lan must open locker 17 while keeping a red evidence folder dry. The steel bench stands directly beside locker 17, so the three shots require no off-shot repositioning. Her jacket hood stays down, leaving the nape anchor visible.

Character — Lin Lan: V-shaped nape hairline; right shoulder slightly lower than left.
Look — LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN: references Lin Lan; low-tied hair; dark-teal matte hooded work jacket; hood down; two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff.
LOCK — LOCK-LINLAN-JACKET: “dark-teal matte hooded work jacket, hood down, two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff”; active in SHOT-01 through SHOT-03.
Prop — brass locker key and red evidence folder remain separate assets. Throughout these three shots, the left arm pins the folder and the left hand supports its lower edge; only the right hand handles the key.

SHOT-01 — Start: folder tucked under left arm, key on the steel bench, right hand empty, gaze on the key. Action: Lin Lan picks up the key with her right hand. End: folder under left arm, key in right hand, gaze shifts to locker 17.
SHOT-02 — Start: inherit the preceding end. Action: she inserts the key into locker 17. End: folder under left arm, key remains in the lock, right hand stays on it, gaze on the keyhole.
SHOT-03 — Start: inherit the preceding end. Action: she turns the key once. End: folder still under left arm, key turned in the lock, right hand on the key, gaze moves to the door seam.

Prompt/reference record: `IMG-CHAR-LINLAN` and `IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN` name prompt entries only. `PLAN-LINLAN-RAIN-01` points to the explicitly non-existent placeholder `剧集/EP001/待提供/林岚雨夜造型.png` below, first in reference order, for identity and compatible Look only; it must not control hand pose, key position, gaze or camera. No real file has been provided, inspected or bound, so all three shots remain PLAN and are not production-ready. No image, video, face-consistency or motion result is claimed.

Copyable text-only handoff request:
For EP001, use `short-drama-assets`, `short-drama-image-prompts` and `short-drama-storyboard` to organize Lin Lan and these three shots. Keep Character, Look, LOCK and shot state separate. Stop at text files; do not generate images, video, voices or music. `剧集/EP001/待提供/林岚雨夜造型.png` is a placeholder path, not an existing file. Keep it as PLAN and do not prepare a production submission.

en: `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`: the Character entry, one compatible Look, separate Props, scoped states and only the necessary continuity LOCK.
`剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md`: copyable `IMG-*` prompt entries carrying the accepted anchors and LOCK text. They are text deliverables, not evidence of generated assets.

`剧集/<EP>/分镜.md`: `SHOT-*` state chains, frozen start frames, visual-basis references and honest `REF-*`, `PLAN-*` or missing-reference status. `视频提示词.md` is added only when the reference path is ready enough for that stage.
zh: `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`：Character 条目、一个相容 Look、独立 Prop、有范围的状态，以及必要的连续性 LOCK。
`剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md`：携带身份锚点与 LOCK 锁面的可复制 `IMG-*` 提示词；它是文本交付，不证明图片已生成。
`剧集/<EP>/分镜.md`：`SHOT-*` 状态链、起点冻结帧、视觉依据，以及真实的 `REF-*`、`PLAN-*` 或缺图状态。参考路径满足该阶段要求后，才按需添加 `视频提示词.md`。

en: Editorially compare all three shots: Character anchors remain the same, the Look is compatible, the exact LOCK surface is carried wherever required, and every hand, prop and gaze at a shot start matches the preceding end.

Audit evidence labels before production: every `REF-*` resolves to an inspected real file with a stated purpose and boundary; unresolved `PLAN-*` slots stay non-production. Passing this document review does not validate or guarantee generated-media quality or continuity.
zh: 逐镜做编辑核对：Character 锚点不变，Look 内部相容，LOCK 锁面在所需位置原样出现；每镜起点的双手、持物与视线都接得上前镜终点。
投产前核对证据等级：每个 `REF-*` 都能找到已检查的真实文件，并写明用途和边界；未解决的 `PLAN-*` 继续保持不可投产。文档审阅通过不等于生成媒体质量或连续性已经验证。
